philippines.description:
COTABATO CITY, BARMM, Philippines — Police authorities in  Soccsksargen or Region 12 announced that eight persons have been arrested and 116 firearms surrendered or recovered during simultaneous law enforcement operations from Oct. 26 to Nov. 1. During the weeklong period, police conducted 109 operations against loose firearms, Brig. Gen. Alan Manibog, Police Regional Office (PRO-12) director, said. Citing a consolidated accomplishment report, Manibog said the Cotabato Police Provincial Office recorded the highest number of operations at 40, resulting in six arrests and the surrender or recovery of 43 firearms. usStocks.title: Palantir and Shopify Both Beat Earnings. Their Stocks are Falling Anyway.
usStocks.description: Apple, Palantir, Shopify, and several other major companies just reported earnings, and Wall Street is sending a clear message: Beating expectations isn't enough when profit margins are under pressure. In this video, Eric Bleeker, CFA, Chief Investment Officer of 24/7 Wall St., breaks down the biggest earnings movers and what their results reveal about the stock market. Apple (Nasdaq: AAPL) beat revenue and earnings expectations as iPhone sales surged 17.5%, but disappointing gross margins raised concerns. Palantir (Nasdaq: PLTR) delivered explosive 96% revenue growth, yet investors are questioning slower growth in U.S. commercial contract value. Shopify (NYSE: SHOP) plunged 16% after missing revenue expectations and disappointing on free cash flow, despite beating earnings estimates. Elsewhere, Revvity (NYSE: RVTY) rallied 9% after raising guidance, while Fiserv (Nasdaq: FISV) jumped 10% on stronger earnings and expanded cost-cutting plans. Meanwhile, Zebra Technologies (Nasdaq: ZBRA) tumbled 16% despite beating estimates and raising its outlook, and Dynatrace (NYSE: DT) cut earnings guidance due to margin pressures. The big takeaway? Investors are increasingly focused on profitability, margins, and forward guidance rather than headline earnings beats alone.
usStocks.source: Yahoo! Finance: AAPL MSFT GOOGL AMZA NVDA News
